projectDescription: LifeSphere is an AI-powered autonomous caregiving ecosystem that unifies continuous biometric monitoring, physical robotic response, emotional intelligence, perimeter security, and biology-responsive home automation into a single synchronized platform—requiring no interaction from the user.
keyFeatures: 14-sensor Vital32 wearable with real-time ECG, SpO2, HRV, GSR, BIA, and fall detection
Immune activation prediction 24–48 hours before symptom onset
Pre-seizure probability estimation up to 30 minutes before onset
HollowRover autonomous mobile robot with ROS2, SLAM, and 3-anchor UWB precision localization
Multi-floor deployment via barometric pressure floor discrimination
6-DOF robotic arm for caregiving assistance and passive security barrier
Autonomous medication dispensing with prescription OCR onboarding
SphereAI trimodal emotional intelligence fusing NLP, vocal prosody, and live biomarkers
EntryGuard perimeter security with facial recognition and multi-sensor threat detection
HollowCore biology-responsive home automation mapping physiology to environment
Financial anomaly detection with biometric multi-factor transaction authorization
Firebase real-time biological state backbone synchronizing all five subsystems at ≤150 ms latency
Fault-tolerant architecture with local SD fallback, GSM backup, and watchdog timers
Islamic cultural integration: salah reminders, adhkar, and Ramadan medication protocol
publicApiSurface: Firebase Realtime Database path: /lifesphere/vital32 — biometric state object
Firebase Realtime Database path: /lifesphere/sphereai — emotional state object
Firebase Realtime Database path: /lifesphere/hollowrover — rover status object
Firebase Realtime Database path: /lifesphere/hollowcore — environment state object
Firebase Realtime Database path: /lifesphere/entryguard — security state object
MQTT topic: lifesphere/hollowcore/command — appliance relay commands
MQTT topic: sphereai/command — SphereAI audio commands
ESP32 Firebase write: vital32 biometric fields (heart_rate, spo2, fall_detected, anomaly_score, seizure_prob)
Python Firebase listener: on_vital32_change — triggers fall/emergency/seizure protocols
Prescription OCR pipeline: extract_prescription(image_path) → structured medication JSON
SphereAI MetaClassifier.fuse(lang_out, voice_out, bio_out, prior_state) → emotional state
HollowRover trilaterate_3anchor(a, b, c, rA, rB, rC) → (x, y) position
Isolation Forest: get_anomaly_score(model, sample) → normalized score 0–1
